threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still take your dog to the park on a lead when everyone else is letting theirs run wild and socialize. It's a whole different vibe here.
Last night on the 36, saw a guy in a tracksuit breakdancing in the aisle. Only in Peckham, am I right? The driver's face was priceless.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Watching the U-Bahn pause for a street festival, locals spilling out with homemade snacks, while the buskers play just for them—it felt like family.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a bar that serves beer through a vending machine at 3 AM. It’s like a late-night revelation on a cobblestone street.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re from here when they think BART delays are an art form and can tell you the best taqueria for a post-evacuation snack.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading commuters at the Civic Center station with a ukulele. He hit every note while people just kept scrolling on their phones.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the Sagrada Família. They miss the quiet charm of Plaça de la Vila, where locals truly unwind.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You'll notice a recent arrival when they still look lost trying to navigate the diagonal intersections. The locals glide through like it's second nature.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still get confused at which way to stand on the escalators during a tube strike. Locals just glide past you like it's second nature.
Last night on the 333, I saw a guy sing an entire Adele song to a bemused elderly couple. They turned their heads like it was a concert, proper London moment.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of grilled kebabs mixed with fresh coffee on any Saturday morning made me realize this is home, not just a place to live.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find nightclub briefs mixed with art exhibits in abandoned buildings—like a concert in a leftover factory, all while sipping on craft beer.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local when they know how to navigate the BART delays without losing their cool—or when they’ve got a backup plan that doesn’t involve Uber.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a glimpse of a guy in a tuxedo waiting for the N-Judah, holding a bouquet. Only in the Tenderloin would a wedding seem like it could happen on the subway.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always miss the tiny plaça on Carrer de Fraternitat where locals gather for evening chess. It’s a real slice of life, not a postcard spot.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by their confusion at the lack of pedestrian crossings; they’ll stand staring at the traffic, waiting for a green light.
